title: MokkenLab: A jamovi Module for Mokken Scale Analysis

creators.name: Chacón Chacón, Arquímedes De León
creators.affiliation: Universidad Católica Andrés Bello (UCAB), Caracas, Venezuela

description: An open-source jamovi module that brings every capability of the mokken R package to jamovi (scalability coefficients with standard errors, confidence intervals and tests, automated item selection, monotonicity, invariant item ordering, nonintersection and conditional association checks, reliability, Guttman-error outliers, norm statistics and two-level Mokken scale analysis), pairing every result with evidence-based methodological guidance, interpretation and educational support in English and Spanish.
